archetype: 5 (Luxury) mixed with 2 (Performance Pro) - Cinematic Tactical Command Center
design_philosophy: A premium, dark-mode gaming dashboard that feels like a tactical command center for MMORPG players. Focuses on high-contrast typography, bento-grid layouts for data density, and restrained terminal-style aesthetics. Avoids flashy purple/neon gamer cliches in favor of a serious, high-end strategy feel.

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Editorial Future' + 'Terminal': Wide Display Sans (Outfit) for expressive, bold hero text, combined with Geometric Body (IBM Plex Sans) for readability, and Monospace (JetBrains Mono) for tactical data points, stats, and overlines.

rules: Use 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights.
Never use pure black #000000; base is tinted with a microscopic warmth.

layout_spacing.system: Tailwind Scale: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) mixed with dense bento grids (gap-4).
layout_spacing.bento_grid: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. Dense bento layouts for stats, build optimizer, and tasks. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-6.
layout_spacing.alignment: Strict grid hierarchy. Left-align most text for readability; use asymmetry in the hero section.
layout_spacing.container_padding: Containers with borders must use internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_cards: Flat background (#121212), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no shadow default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and sharpens border contrast.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky nav / overlays. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.terminal_look: Used for the 'AI Strategy Chat' and 'Build Optimizer' outputs to feel like calculated readouts. JetBrains mono, subtle red/amber data highlights.

components.strategy: Hybrid: Pure HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing/hero layouts. Heavily customized Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, dropdowns, tabs.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-md). Solid primary background with white text, or pure outline with text hover.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav with glassmorphism. Contains Game Selector dropdown (Shadcn), User Auth, and primary links. Mobile gets hamburger.
components.game_cards: Asymmetric bento cards. Top section features absolute positioned image with gradient overlay (to black), bottom features stats/tags.
components.ai_chat: Dedicated panel. AI responses stream with typewriter effect. Terminal styling for strategy steps.

animations.hover_states: Crisp, fast. Background lightens by 5%, border opacity increases.
animations.page_transitions: Framer motion fade and slight slide-up (y: 10 to 0).
animations.staggered_lists: Bento grid items stagger in on load.

media_and_assets.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for high-end duotone feel.

hero_background.description: 3D abstract tactical game background. Use with heavy black gradient overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure text readability.

login_accent.description: Gold chess pieces on black, symbolizing strategy and intellect.

game_card_placeholder_1.description: Intense warrior portrait for RPG game cards.

game_card_placeholder_2.description: Mandalorian/Sci-fi warrior portrait for strategy games.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. Text on dark background must be #A1A1AA or brighter.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='game-selector-dropdown', data-testid='ai-chat-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Shadcn UI for dropdown-menu, dialog, tabs, card, scroll-area, and input components.
Apply the JetBrains Mono font specifically to data readouts and the Build Optimizer section to simulate a tactical terminal.
Use the Bento Grid layout (CSS Grid with col-span/row-span) for the Dashboard View.
For the AI Chat, implement a streaming typing effect.
Strictly enforce the dark theme. Do NOT use purple or violet gradients.
Wrap grid items correctly when animating with Framer Motion (motion.div must be the direct child or apply subgrid).

List of 37Games to include in the Game Selector: Puzzles & Conquest, Puzzles & Survival, Legend: Rise of Mythic Heroes, Soul Land Reloaded, Days of Empire, Era of Conquest, Infinity Kingdom, League of Angels, Wartune, Dynasty Origins: Conquest.
